title: Clevis Mount Bracket (drawing CMB-250605-01, Rev A)
general_tolerance_note: ISO 2768-m; 1st angle projection; all dimensions in mm; break all sharp edges 0.2 to 0.5 mm; remove all burrs and sharp edges; surface finish Ra 1.6 µm unless otherwise specified; machined surfaces only; heat treat T6; finish as-machined

inner span dimension across the fork (front view)
slot width between the fork prongs (front view)
2 chamfers 2.0×45 on the fork prong tops
pin bore diameter, ISO tolerance class H7, THRU (+0.021/0)
fillet radius at the fork-to-body transition (front view)
overall height of the bracket (front view / section A-A)
base plate thickness (section A-A / side view)
fork outer width in section A-A
fillet radius in section A-A
lug-head outer radius (right side view)
bracket height dimension in section A-A
base width shown in the right side view
overall length of the base plate (top view)
longitudinal mounting-hole spacing (with ±0.1)
overall width of the base plate (top view)
transverse mounting-hole spacing (with ±0.1)
base edge-margin to mounting holes (appears twice)
4 mounting holes Ø11.0 THRU
counterbore diameter for the Ø11.0 mounting holes
counterbore depth for the Ø11.0 mounting holes

scoring.match_rule: An LLM-extracted dimension matches a GT entry if (a) kind matches OR is a compatible alias, (b) numerical value within ±0.05 (mm precision), (c) tolerances within ±0.05 if specified. Compound counterbore annotations like '4 × Ø11.0 THRU ⌴ Ø20.0 ▽ 6.0' are split into hole pattern + counterbore diameter + counterbore depth; the model gets credit for each independently. A feature dimensioned in more than one view is counted once. ISO tolerance class H7 is recorded in 'as_drawn'; the explicit +0.021/0 deviation is what is scored for that feature.
scoring.passing_threshold: Strong = recall and precision >= 0.85; Pass = both >= 0.70.
